title: eppoFindeR
text: .Renviron file used define environment variables R loads automatically start session. approach particularly convenient sensitive information like API keys, allows use R script function without hardcoding . text: main purpose eppoFindeR query EPPO database specific EPPO codes retrieve relevant information across various endpoints. endpoint, can either: Query available services obtain comprehensive data. title: Query the EPPO API Country endpoints. — country
text: isoCodes character (vector). One ISO codes query. ISO country codes standardized identifiers countries territories. codes, typically consisting two-letter, provide unique consistent abbreviations country names. ISO coding system enables easy management, exchange, integration country information across databases systems. ISO country codes related data can accessed via ISO Online Browsing Platform. services character (vector). One Country services query. Common service names include: overview, categorization presence. validation step ensures provided services match supported service names. default: services. apiKey character (string). API key used authentication. can specified manually .Renviron file. default: Sys.getenv("EPPO_API_KEY").

title: Query the EPPO API Country endpoints. — country
text: named list results, level corresponds data retrieved specified service. service element contains flattened dataframe queried content specified ISO codes.

title: Query the EPPO API Country endpoints. — country

title: Create a complete and uniform taxonomy dataframe. — uniformTaxonomy
text: dataframe row represents one expected taxonomic ranks. Fields corresponding ranks present original taxonomy filled NA. level column excluded output. column queried_eppo_code NA values filled right code.

title: Create a complete and uniform taxonomy dataframe. — uniformTaxonomy
